                    <div class="cooked"><p>Hello,<br>
I have been searching the last days, informations and documentations about the IMU sensor MPU6050 from Invensense. I would like to use this sensor to <span class="bbcode-u">measuring distance</span>, like a motion tracking ,for example: if the board with the sensor moves 1 meter, I want to calculate this 1 meter from the data receiveid from the MPU6050, the data doesn't need to be very accurate. I found a lote of aplication with static moviment, moving static cubes for example, but I didn't find any aplication example mensuring distance.<br>
According to my search the sensor give the digital-output of 6 or 9-axis MotionFusion data in rotation matrix, quaternion, Euler Angle, or raw data format, but how can I calculate the distance from this data.</p>
<p><strong>Please, could one that is familiar with IMU sensors ou familiar with complex math, could give me an ideia to start my project? I would like to have some example, but if isn't possible, any information about mensuring distance with MPU6050 will be welcome.</strong></p>
<p>Thank you very much!<br>
Celso</p><div class="cooked-selection-barrier" aria-hidden="true"><br></div></div><!---->
